cycle.rule: a hold on every elapsed day d with (d + 3) mod 294 = 0
cycle.cycle: 294 x 364 = 107016 elapsed days; 364 holds, each calendar position held once; 293 corrected years
cycle.cycle_year: corrected Enoch years whose Day 1 falls in the cycle, 1..293
cycle.span_cycle: the cycle whose elapsed-day span contains the day (its first day is a hold, not a Day 1)
cycle.epoch: counted from the epoch (a model convention)

priests.rule: weeks run Sunday to the Sabbath, unbroken (the paper's (d + 3) // 7); Qumran order from Gamul; the first week of each 294-year cycle is Gamul's
priests.source: 1 Chronicles 24:7-18 (the 24 courses); Qumran order beginning with Gamul
priests.structure: 294-year cycle = 15,288 weeks = 637 rotations = 49 six-year cycles of 312 weeks (13 rotations each)
